name: craft
description: Specify behavior, build minimally, audit decisions, check drift, and close tasks through a gated review loop.

interface.shortDescription: Specify, build, review, detect drift, and learn
interface.longDescription: A personal spec-driven workflow combining compact specifications, minimal implementation, decision audits, read-only drift detection, a gated build-audit-check loop, and defect backpropagation.
defaultPrompt: Use $craft:spec to turn this idea into SPEC.md.
Use $craft:build --next to complete the next task.
Use $craft:full-loop --next --loop to build, review, and finish the next task.
